text:
Alice T: heads-up — our sampleapp rerank started throwing reshape errors in prod canary this morning
Ben K: what’s the stack trace look like?
Alice T: client-side error: ValueError: cannot reshape array of size 1536 into shape ( -1, 768) — but payload contains 2 vectors of 768 and 768 and one of 512?
Priya R: wait how would that happen? we only onboarded one model variant for rerank (v1-embed-768)
Alice T: that's the weird part — smart-routing fallback kicked in for a single request and returned a vector from model v1-lite-512 for one item, so a mixed-dim response landed in the batcher
Ben K: ah — batch helper assumes homogeneous dims and concatenates then does `np.reshape(-1, vec_dim)` — will blow up on mixed dims
Priya R: any auth/ retry interplay? we had some 401->refresh->retry traces earlier
Alice T: yes, auth-bot shows token refresh at 11:03:12 and an in-flight retry was triggered; two similar requests hit slightly different routing decisions and the helper merged them into one outgoing batch
Ben K: that explains ordering issues too — if retries are deduped differently by idempotency layer, order can get shuffled
Alice T: repro steps I used locally: run sampleapp with 3 queries, set MODEL_FALLBACK_RATE=0.2 to simulate variant fallback, run batcher with batching=true
Alice T: minimal payload used:
```json
{"queries":["foo","bar","baz"], "batch":true}
```
Priya R: sample bad response snippet we saw:
```json
{"results":[{"id":0,"vec":[...512 floats...]},{"id":1,"vec":[...768 floats...]},{"id":2,"vec":[...768 floats...]}], "meta":{"routing":["v1-lite-512","v1-embed-768","v1-embed-768"]}}
```
Ben K: proposed short-term mitigations: 1) batcher add per-item vec_dim validation and reject mixed batches, 2) preserve source order metadata, 3) add retry-id dedupe to prevent double-merge of near-duplicate requests
Alice T: I pushed a hotfix branch that falls back to per-item calls if dims mismatch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sherpa/compare/fix/mixed-dim-fallback
Priya R: I'll add a test in sampleapp/integration that injects a mixed-dim response and asserts we surface an explanatory error instead of crash
Ben K: runtime note for eng-runtime — if quantized kernel paths or variant swaps could change output length, we must document that model variants must preserve vector length in the model catalog and validation pipeline
Priya R: docs gap: onboarding guide never mentions explicit `vec_dim` contract — people assume models in a rerank endpoint are interchangeably sized
DevEx Bot: incident-tag: dx-embed-dim-swap; severity: low; owner: devex; ticket: DEVEX-1137
auth-bot: token-refresh: 2025-08-14T11:03:12Z; retries: 2
Alice T: follow-ups: (A) backport helper validation to 0.8.x SDK, (B) add preserve_order flag to batcher default false -> make opt-in true for apps requiring strict ordering, (C) add integration test simulating auth latency: `AUTH_DELAY_MS=2500 make test-integration`, (D) runtime ticket to enforce vec_dim parity across model variants
Ben K: lgtm. I'll coordinate patch review and canary deploy. schedule canary?
DevEx Bot: canary deploy requested: 2025-08-15T02:00:00Z
Alice T: thanks team. TL;DR: mixed-dim responses from model-variant fallback + auth-retry merge caused reshape crash; temp fix = per-vector dim validation & fallback; longer fix = SDK de-dupe + model-catalog vec_dim invariant.
